description: Test-coverage exclusions used by tools/create-dependency-graph/ to compute an 'effective coverage' metric alongside the raw CDG number. Files matched by any category below are intentionally not direct-imported by a vitest *.test.ts file but are exercised through one of the documented indirect paths. See docs/Architecture/COVERAGE_POLICY.md for the full policy.

synced_mathjs_functions.label: Synced mathjs categories in functions/
synced_mathjs_functions.rationale: Mechanically synced from upstream mathjs by ~/.claude/scripts/sync_mathjs_to_mathts.py. Exercised end-to-end through the active functions/src/typed/ dispatch layer (1,774 functions tests). Per CLAUDE.md: 'synced files are dormant — they are NOT exported from functions/src/index.ts directly; only functions/src/typed/ contains active implementations.'

synced_wasm_bindings.label: Synced WASM binding helpers under functions/src/wasm/
synced_wasm_bindings.rationale: Same sync source as the mathjs categories. Exercised via the active functions/src/wasm/{WasmLoader,integrity,MatrixWasmBridge}.ts files and functions/src/wasm/bitwise/wasm-bridge.ts, all of which DO have direct tests.

synced_expression_utils.label: Synced expression utils + transforms
synced_expression_utils.rationale: Synced from mathjs. expression/src/utils/ has its own direct tests (utils-array, utils-bignumber-formatter, …); only files NOT covered there fall into this bucket — exercised transitively via the parser and compiler tests.

synced_core_helpers.label: Synced helpers in core/src/
synced_core_helpers.rationale: Hand-ported analogues of mathjs utils that share the same factory pattern. Exercised through core/src/{numeric,typed,factory}/ which DO have direct tests.

assemblyscript_sources.label: AssemblyScript sources under assembly/src/
assemblyscript_sources.rationale: AssemblyScript is not a vitest target. Exercised end-to-end by the cross-package WASM integration suite invoked via `npm run test:wasm:integration` (224/224 passing across 11 files). Direct-import test files in vitest cannot meaningfully cover AS-only syntax.

type_only_barrels.label: Type-only files
type_only_barrels.rationale: Pure interface / type declarations with no runtime to exercise. A vitest test would be a no-op.
